name: Genshin Impact
tagline: Working Genshin Impact codes for free Primogems, Mora and Hero's Wit.
description: Genshin Impact is HoYoverse's open-world action RPG, set in the fantasy world of Teyvat. HoYoverse releases new redemption codes during every version livestream (typically the day a new version goes live), plus occasional codes for milestones, partnerships and special events. Codes expire quickly — usually within 24 to 48 hours — so it pays to redeem them the moment they drop.

redeemSteps.title: Reach Adventure Rank 10
redeemSteps.detail: Your account must be at least AR 10 before you can redeem any code. New players: clear the Statue of the Seven quest in Mondstadt first.

redeemSteps.title: Open the redemption page
redeemSteps.detail: Go to the official HoYoverse redemption portal at genshin.hoyoverse.com/en/gift. You can also redeem in-game via Settings → Account → Redeem Now (mobile only).

redeemSteps.title: Log in with your HoYoverse account
redeemSteps.detail: Use the same account linked to your Genshin Impact profile. Pick the correct server (America, Europe, Asia or TW/HK/MO).

redeemSteps.title: Enter the code
redeemSteps.detail: Paste the code exactly as shown. Codes are case-sensitive.

redeemSteps.title: Claim in-game
redeemSteps.detail: Rewards arrive via in-game mail. Open Paimon menu → Mail and tap Claim. Mail is held for 30 days.

faq.question: How long do Genshin Impact codes stay active?
faq.answer: Livestream codes usually expire 24 to 48 hours after they're announced. Permanent codes like GENSHINGIFT remain active indefinitely. Always redeem fresh codes immediately.

faq.question: Why does my Genshin code say 'invalid'?
faq.answer: Common reasons: the code expired, you typed it incorrectly (codes are case-sensitive), or you selected the wrong server. Double-check each before contacting support.

faq.question: Can I redeem the same code on multiple servers?
faq.answer: No. Each code can be redeemed once per HoYoverse account, on a single server.

faq.question: Where do my rewards go after redeeming?
faq.answer: Primogems, Mora and items arrive via in-game mail within a few minutes. Open Paimon menu → Mail to claim them within 30 days.

codes.notes: Permanent code for new and returning players.
